  "reasoning": "All 16 selected answers are mathematically correct and established by their own captured worked solutions. Completing the square gives (z+5)^2=75 for q-3435, hence p+q=80 and z=-5±5√3; for q-12995 it gives (z+5)^2=50 and p+q=55. For q-66902, z=-ln(4)/5≈-0.277258, which rounds to -0.277. Common denominators give (6+x)/(3x(1+z)) for q-69903, with x≠0 and z≠-1, and (2p+5)/p for q-113217, with p≠0. Derivative units are output units divided by input units, confirming q-110042 and q-48611. With fixed rectangle height h, A(b)=hb and A′(b)=h; for the pentagon P(s)=5s and P′(s)=5, confirming the rate interpretations. The tangent slope in q-48709 means an instantaneous increase of 1.5 thousand visitors per hour at hour 10; q-48571 means an instantaneous increase of 650 users per hour at hour 4. Evaluating c(5)=100·5^(-1)=20 gives the positive rate of decrease in q-112383. In q-48914, t=8 and births minus deaths equals 500·2−400·3=-200 elephants per year. By definition, N′(t)=r(t) and A′(t)=r(t) in q-72004 and q-72105. Finally, the fourth-quadrant argument is 2π−arctan(2/3)≈5.69518, rounding to 5.70. Two authored explanatory errors are preserved here: q-69903 says there are no common factors in the denominators, although both contain 1+z; q-72105 says 'after $t$ hours' although the question defines t in minutes. Neither changes its field answer. No submitted grade or earlier answer is supplied; confirmation rests on the captured worked solutions.",
